segments.text: V. 33, 34 Whoſoever ſhall deny me before men—To which ye will be ſtrongly tempted. For think not that I am come—That is, think not that univerſal Peace will be the immediate Conſequence of my Coming. Juſt the Contrary. Both publick and private Diviſions will follow, whereſoever my Goſpel comes with Power. Yet this is not the Deſign, tho' it be the Event, of his Coming, thro' the Oppoſition of Devils and Men.
